name: spark-outpost-share
description: Hosts the pages people share from Spark Outpost.

UPLOAD_KEY.description: The key Spark Outpost must send to upload a page: 32 to 128 letters, digits, - or _, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Paste the same value into Spark Outpost.

SIGNING_KEY.description: A random value of at least 32 characters that signs page frames and unlock cookies, for example from `openssl rand -base64 48`. Nothing else needs it.
